verdict.rationale: Baseten documents its own stable development, staging, and production environments for deployments. Truss adds a development loop with live reload and a model server that behaves the same in development and production, so you can test a model before promoting it. The evidence is thin, though: it never describes a sandbox that isolates data, test API keys, or how non-production environments are kept away from production traffic and data. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox or test-mode docs, data and credential isolation between environments, test keys for Model APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
